title: Form layouts
description: Arrange fields in tabs, sections and columns and define when each field shows up or becomes required.

contexts.label: Form
contexts.createHint: Used when creating records. Required fields are always added.
contexts.editHint: Used when editing records. Without an edit layout, the rules of the create layout also apply to edits.
contexts.viewHint: Used in the side panel of the record page. Only visibility rules are accepted.

status.default: Default layout generated from the fields

palette.title: Available fields
palette.empty: Every field is already in the layout.
palette.hint: Drag a field to a column or use the picker of each column.

fields.locked: Required field: always part of the create form.

rules.title: Rules of {{field}}
rules.description: Conditions use the values filled in the form. Only fields in the layout can be used.
rules.noRequiredInView: View layouts do not use required rules.
rules.hiddenNotRequired: A hidden field is never required.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Try the rules by filling in the fields. Nothing is saved.
preview.submitted: Preview: the form would be submitted.

confirmReset.title: Restore the default layout?
confirmReset.description: The custom {{form}} layout will be removed and the form is generated from the fields again.

toast.error: The layout could not be saved.

errors.load: The layout could not be loaded.
errors.unavailable: This record type is not available.
